name: The St. Anthony
positioning: Historic 1909 downtown hotel, officially The St. Anthony, a Luxury Collection Hotel, San Antonio, overlooking Travis Park near The Alamo and the River Walk
best_for: Travelers who want a historic downtown base steps from The Alamo and the River Walk
Guests who enjoy antiques, fine art and old grand-hotel history

facts.text: The St. Anthony is a historic hotel dating from 1909.
The hotel blends marble detailing and Corinthian columns with modern sophistication.
The hotel is steps from The Alamo and the River Walk.
Rooms and suites feature rich velvet, Italian marble and gold accents.
The Presidential Suite is a three-bedroom suite designed as a private residence for grand entertaining.
The presidential suites have views of Travis Park.
The John Wayne Suite has a separate living and dining area, a wet bar, a walk-in closet and marble bathrooms with a soaking tub.
The Franklin Suite is a one-bedroom suite with a living and dining space, a wet bar and a spa-style marble bath.
Event spaces range from the ornate Peraux Ballroom, adorned with 19th-century French tapestries, to the Sky Terrace overlooking downtown.
The hotel champions local talent with live music, pop-up markets and art shows.
The concierge will handle problems such as lost luggage or a canceled flight and can arrange a last-minute dinner reservation.
Big business deals at The St. Anthony Club ranged from the formation of Southwest Airlines to the purchase of the San Antonio Spurs.

highlights.text: The hotel is filled with French Empire antique furniture and museum-quality sculptures, paintings and tapestries.
The hotel's guest list has included presidents, princesses and celebrities such as Ginger Rogers, John Wayne and George Clooney.
The rooftop pool is an outdoor infinity pool with private cabanas.
The hotel overlooks downtown San Antonio and Travis Park.
The St. Anthony Club is a storied lounge for craft cocktails, decorated in the 1950s by Dorothy Draper.

considerations.text: The minimum age to check in is 21.
Rooms do not have a fridge.
WhataHotel notes the historic building may have older infrastructure.
